links.surface: أَحْمَدِ بْنِ زِيادِ بْنِ جَعْفَر الهَمْدانِيَّ

notes: needs_ruling: Safwan's account is in the first person («خِفْنَا عَلَيْهِ»، «فَقُلْتُ لَهُ»); the Imam al-Rida speaks inside the scene, and he is not added as a link.
«فَأَخْبَرَنَا الثِّقَةُ» inside the saying is a second report with its own unnamed transmitter; it is not written as a route. «رَضِىَ اللهُ عَنْهُ» and the footnote number are left out.

levels.surface: أحمد بن زياد بن جعفر الهمداني

notes: Safwan is the last link. The Imam al-Rida speaks inside Safwan's narrated encounter («فقال ليجهد جهده»), so the Imam is not added: whether he is source or only in the scene is a ruling (rule 11).
«الثقة» in «فأخبرنا الثقة» is inside the matn, not a chain link.
